detail: Rights Issue — Shah Metacorp Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on May 21, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 36 : 311, i.e 36 Equity Shares for every 311 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 486 per share.
